title: Per-token admission + eviction correlation canvas for multi-region graceful-degrade
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: instrument and build a correlation dashboard that surfaces how per-token admission decisions and KV-cache/worker evictions propagate into token-level latency SLO violations across regions, and to provide actionable thresholds for circuit breakers and adaptive shedding.

Scope:
- Define per-token SLIs: admitted_token_p50/p95/p99, eviction_rate_per_1000_tokens, kv_hit_fraction_by_prefix, admit_reject_ratio, replication-fallback-latency.
- Implement telemetry hooks at admission broker and executor to emit token-level events with route, model_variant, region, shard_id, and reason_code (admit/evict/hit/miss).
- Aggregate series for per-route and cross-region rolling windows (1m, 5m, 1h) and compute correlation matrices between eviction spikes and p99 token latency regressions.
- Dashboard components: time-aligned heatmap of evictions vs p99, trace-linked sample of affected requests, regional spillovers, circuit-breaker state timeline, and suggested threshold widgets for auto-shed rules.
- Integrations: link traces to existing tracing (X-Request-ID), surface related PR runs and synthetic-test IDs so SREs can replay.

Non-goals: changing production shedding policy in this ticket; threshold rollout will be a follow-up with canary steps.
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry emitted from admission and executor with required fields in 95% of sampled requests
Grafana dashboard shows aligned eviction and token-p99 heatmaps for 1m/5m/1h windows
Correlation panel computes Pearson/Kendall indicators and flags >0.6 correlations
Runbook section drafted describing playbook for eviction-induced SLO regressions
Linked synthetic job (job id) reproduces an eviction spike and dashboard shows expected signal
